observationsNotFindings: The file 08 pin is the quiet correctness in this fold. D-170 moved HEAD and COORD but edited no register cell, so file 08's digest is unchanged from before it. A successor that refreshed all three governing pins mechanically would have been wrong about file 08; this one carries the unchanged f909ddff alongside the moved COORD and HEAD. That is the difference between re-measuring and assuming a moved world moves everything.

The actor-join repair is the substantively interesting part and it is done with the right granularity. The finding could have been answered by pointing OBL-ACTOR-JOIN at DR-G32 wholesale; instead the obligation now carries a two-limb routing — execution as qualification at the live G32, authoring and integration still riding DR-114 — which matches what D-169 and D-170 actually established. Its own leftoverDesign flag stays false and the eight-member set is untouched, so recognising a live owner did not migrate a DR-114 obligation onto DR-105.

This is now the fourth time in this corpus that a role sentence naming a concrete successor version has gone stale on a fold, and the pattern of which roles fail is completely consistent: every role using 'Not this artifact's version number' has survived every fold, and every role using 'This vN' has eventually broken. In this file four roles use the immune form and one does not, and the one that does not is the finding. The corpus would be rid of this class entirely by adopting the generic form as convention.
